sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay of Swipe Art Puzzle revolves around recreating famous paintings by rearranging puzzle pieces. The game starts with a grid of pieces that need to be rearranged to form a complete image. The twist here is that each piece is a puzzle in itself, and players need to swipe them in the right direction to move them into place. As players progress through the game, the puzzles get increasingly difficult, requiring more complex moves to complete.

The game also has a special 'swap' feature that allows players to swap two pieces of the same color. This feature is crucial in completing the puzzles, especially towards the end of the game. Players will need to use this feature strategically to move pieces into place and complete the image.

One of the unique features of Swipe Art Puzzle is its 'undo' feature. Players can undo their moves at any time, which is especially helpful when they realize they've made a mistake. This feature makes the game more relaxing and enjoyable, as players can experiment with different moves without worrying about messing up the entire puzzle.

Overall, the core gameplay of Swipe Art Puzzle is simple yet addictive, making it perfect for players of all ages and skill levels.
